data.name: Carpark Hero
data.detailed_description:
Every round is an intense sprint to claim a parking spot before your friends do.

There’s always one fewer spot than players, so if you don’t park your car, you’re eliminated. It all builds to a chaotic, high-stakes 1v1 final showdown where only one car can be crowned the winner. Its just like musical chairs but with parking spaces, wacky physics, big hits and lots of laughs.

If you get eliminated early, come back as a ghost car and exact revenge and sabotage your friends

Use proximity voice chat to talk trash to your friends as you drift past them and all gather around to watch them explode when they are eliminated.

To keep things unpredictable, parking spot locations are randomized every round, so no two races feel the same.

Carpark Hero can be played 2- 8 players.

Vehicle combat, Big Crashes, Big Laughs

Wacky physics make every high-speed crash unpredictable, sending players flying in every direction and creating fresh chaos each match. Sabotage your friends with piercing missiles, blasting them back to the start and crushing their chances of claiming a parking spot.

Use the deflective dome to send missiles flying back and smash through your friends. Pair it with a speed boost, and your car becomes an unstoppable wrecking ball.

An ever growing list of maps and customisation

Carpark Hero boasts a massive range of unique handcrafted maps, each with their own layout, theme and mechanics.

A huge amount of game modifiers

Mix and match a huge amount of game modifiers to always keep the game fresh every single play though:

  • First person mode

  • Night mode and hazardous weather such as snow and rain

  • Manual cars

  • Empty parking lot

  • Free for all and Cooperative golf mode

  • and many more!
